strings.name: Richard Liu
strings.summary: Liu began in Beijing electronics retail and developed JD’s online direct retail and warehousing and delivery network, making supply-chain capability central to its model. He remained chairman after leaving the CEO role in 2022 and discusses food delivery and overseas strategy; his record also includes US sexual-assault allegations and a civil settlement.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: He founded JD.com and developed e-commerce and logistics networks, helping scale online retail supply chains and delivery services.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Sociology bachelor’s degree, Renmin University, 1996; EMBA, China Europe International Business School, 2011.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Combining retail and fulfillment
strings.highlights.h1.text: Direct procurement, warehouses and delivery supported merchandise sales and later logistics for outside merchants; the network required teams and sustained investment.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Moving toward chairman responsibilities
strings.highlights.h2.text: After leaving the CEO post he retained the chairmanship and strategic involvement, rather than all daily executive duties.
strings.timeline.t1.title: JD completes the CECONOMY takeover
strings.timeline.t1.text: During his chairmanship, the group completed its public offer for 59.8% of the European retailer, expanding abroad; this was a corporate transaction.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Reaffirming food delivery and overseas expansion
strings.timeline.t2.text: At a Beijing discussion he criticized earlier lack of innovation and emphasized new businesses and overseas markets, with goals still requiring execution.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Settling a US civil lawsuit
strings.timeline.t3.text: He settled the civil case brought by Liu Jingyao, who accused him of sexual assault; terms were undisclosed. Prosecutors had declined criminal charges; settlement was not a conviction.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Stepping down as JD CEO
strings.timeline.t4.text: He handed the CEO role to Xu Lei while remaining chairman, changing the level of his leadership responsibilities.
strings.timeline.t5.title: JD lists on Nasdaq
strings.timeline.t5.text: Its American depositary shares began trading as JD, providing a capital-market platform for e-commerce and logistics expansion.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Building an owned logistics network
strings.timeline.t6.text: He began developing nationwide warehousing and delivery, emphasizing reliable fulfillment beyond a transaction-only platform.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Moving to online retail
strings.timeline.t7.text: He launched JD’s online store, later closing physical outlets and shifting the business toward internet sales.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Opening an electronics shop in Beijing
strings.timeline.t8.text: He founded JD’s retail predecessor, gaining experience in procurement, merchandise management and customer service.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Completing university
strings.timeline.t9.text: He earned a sociology bachelor’s degree at Renmin University before entering work and retail entrepreneurship.
